author: TurkishDelite
body: I know this is a issue that everyone complains about in game so i wanted to make a post about it. for a lot of people the jump pads are very glitchy in many ways. in my opinion they should take out the jump pads and replace them with command blocks that tp you to the other side. i know someone would reply to this with "they will break the command blocks" this is just an idea to something that could be bigger.

replies.body: WHAT. Axis was removed? That was by far my absolute favourite map on avicus ever. I know it soemtimes glitched, but that only happened to me when I was lagging because of my own internet, not because of the lag coming from the server. Normally the map devs do really well, but i can't agree with this decision to remove axis.
